full_intended_system: Authority-scale intelligence, distribution truth, yield feedback, and post-2026 continuity around the existing client editorial system.
publication_rule: No authority-scale sidecar may approve, publish, revoke, reschedule, or bypass the existing admin workflow.
continuity_rule: Maintain a rolling 120-day future inventory in the existing approval pathway without changing release cadence or approval semantics.
100k_rule: 100K is a deterministic combinatorial fanout/opportunity-ID space for planning intelligence; it is not a curated backlog, page quota, citation count, or claim that 100K semantically qualified opportunities exist. Actionable candidates remain separately clustered/scored/gated downstream.
